name: DHL Supply Chain - DC - Edgerton KS (Logistics Park Kansas City)

fieldNotes.location: DHL Supply Chain operates this single-tenant DC at 32190 W 191st St, Edgerton KS 66021 within Logistics Park Kansas City (LPKC). Roster lng was ~1.1km too far west (landed on the BNSF intermodal yard); corrected via web search + Street View pano confirming the building.
fieldNotes.customer: Building bears prominent 'HERSHEY' signage on the office front (confirmed in two Street View captures, Aug 2024). This is a DHL-operated dedicated-customer DC for The Hershey Company — consistent with DHL Supply Chain's contract-logistics model and with directory listings ('DHL Supply Chain - Edgerton, KS', ph 913-856-2414).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint at either driveway entrance on W 191st St. Both the east and west driveways are open paved drives with only a small address monument sign. Open spec-building access typical of LPKC.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at either entrance — Street View confirms open driveways with no staffed structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: false because there is no truck gate at all (open access).
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate driveways off W 191st St (east end and west end of the building) both lead to the north truck court; trucks can enter one and exit the other. truckGateCount=2.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: All loading docks on the north face. Counted ~38-45 dock positions with trailers backed in at z19; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A marked trailer-parking lot sits at the NW corner / north court holding drop trailers; estimated 10-25 stalls. Low confidence on exact count — adjacent large trailer lot to the NW belongs to a separate parcel and was excluded.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open driveway aprons and broad north truck court provide ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: LPKC sits in rural Johnson County farmland on the SW edge of the KC metro; the building is bordered by open cropland to the south. Rural.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: W 191st St is a low-traffic industrial-park road with deep open driveways; a truck queue would not spill onto a public artery.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Broad paved north truck court provides interior holding/queue space ahead of the docks.
